name: Minoan eruption of Thera (Santorini)
summary: Large volcanic eruption that buried the Bronze Age town of Akrotiri on Santorini. Radiocarbon and archaeological dating give different years.

claims.note: Radiocarbon dating points to the late 17th century BCE (Manning et al. 2014).
The conventional archaeological date, from Aegean and Egyptian pottery sequences, falls in the 16th century BCE or later.
